senses.definition_en: Footprint or mark left by the feet on the ground.

examples.english:
“I still haven't managed to forget you.
Every day I return to the same beach.
I try desperately to find your footprints.
But the sea, in a desperate attempt
to get you away from me
so as not to hurt you more,
hides them by covering them with its waters.”
examples.text:
«Aún no he logrado olvidarte.
Todos los días vuelvo a la misma playa.
Trato desesperadamente de encontrar tus huélligas.
Pero el mar, en un intento desesperado
por alejarte de mi lado
para no hacerte más daño,
las oculta cubriéndolas con sus aguas».
examples.translation:
“I still haven't managed to forget you.
Every day I return to the same beach.
I try desperately to find your footprints.
But the sea, in a desperate attempt
to get you away from me
so as not to hurt you more,
hides them by covering them with its waters.”

glosses: Footprint or mark left by the feet on the ground.
